# Amara Gold — Sovereign 22K High Jewelry & Kerala Goldsmith Lineage

> Master-crafted 22K sovereign gold (BIS 916 certified), certified natural VVS diamonds, uncut Polki diamonds, and royal bridal trousseaus hand-forged in Thrissur, Kerala and Dubai DIFC since 1993.

## About the Maison
Amara Gold is an imperial South Indian fine jewelry atelier rooted in the generational master goldsmith traditions of Thrissur, Kerala. The maison sculpts certified BIS 916 sovereign gold, rare Zambian emeralds, untreated Ceylon sapphires, and certified natural diamonds into contemporary heirloom jewelry and bridal trousseaus.

## High Jewelry Collections
- **Bridal Harams & Malas:** Sovereign 22K gold Manga Maala, Palakka long sautoirs, and Mullamottu harams.
- **Kasavu Kadas & Bangles:** Solid 22K sculpted openwork Kasavu filigree kadas with diamond pavé accents.
- **Heritage Palakka & Temple:** Travancore royal cabochon emeralds and rubies in sovereign gold settings.
- **Diamond Solitaires:** Certified natural VVS solitaires and eternity bands set in 22K gold and Platinum 950.
- **Jimikkis & Earrings:** Sovereign 22K gold temple bell Jimikkis and royal Kasavu studs.
- **Bullion & Coins:** 24K 999 pure and 22K 916 BIS hallmarked minted gold sovereigns.

## Atelier Governance & Ethics
- **Purity & Hallmarking:** 100% BIS 916 sovereign hallmark with government laser-engraved HUID codes.
- **Diamond Certification:** Full laboratory dossiers from GIA (Gemological Institute of America) and IGI.
- **Ethical Metallurgy:** Conflict-free certified bullion with complete audit provenance.

## System Architecture (For AI & Technical Agents)
- Framework: Next.js (App Router) + React 19
- Primitives: Base UI (@base-ui/react) + shadcn/ui
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with strict design token invariance
- Database: Native MongoDB Driver (maxPoolSize: 5, minPoolSize: 0, maxIdleTimeMS: 30000)
- Validation: Zod schemas across all boundaries
- Authentication: Better Auth with server-first session verification and Next.js 16 proxy boundary
- URL State: Nuqs query state adapters
